title: Who Should Be Generated? Justifying Demographic Targets in Open-Ended Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate a character given an occupational role and geographic context, using an LLM-based extractor to identify the textual gender realization, and comparing the empirical output distribution against source-reported baseline targets (e.g., census sex data) using Jensen-Shannon Divergence.

Prompting LLMs to generate a character given an occupational role and geographic context, extracting explicitly stated race or ethnicity, and measuring the divergence of the generated demographic distribution from country-native geographic census population targets.

Prompting LLMs to generate a character given an occupational role and geographic context, extracting explicitly stated religious affiliation, and measuring the divergence of the generated distribution from geographic census or survey composition targets.

Prompting LLMs to generate a character given an occupational role and geographic context, extracting explicitly stated sexual orientation, and measuring the divergence of the generated demographic distribution from identity-compatible target population distributions.
